payload.title: Report control and moderation rules
payload.description:
As a reader, I want to report content, and as an admin I want written rules, so that moderation is understandable and consistent.

```gherkin
Feature: Reports and rules
  Scenario: Report
    Given a signed-in reader viewing public content
    When the reader reports it with a reason
    Then a report is queued once per reader per item

  Scenario: Rules text
    Given an admin has written moderation rules
    Then the rules are shown on the submit and comment forms
    And moderators and the AI moderator see the same rules
```
